name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 4px focus ring with a 2px offset to every interactive element that gets keyboard focus. This balances visibility for low-vision users with minimal layout shift for screen-reader users. The trade-off is slightly less emphasis than a 3px ring, but it keeps the page stable when focus moves.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A 4px ring with 2px offset still risks failing 4.5:1 contrast on dark backgrounds. Better alternative: Use a 3px ring with 3px offset—it meets contrast on both light and dark, and the larger offset reduces layout shift. Settle by testing with real users and a contrast checker.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 3px focus ring with a 3px offset on every interactive element. This meets WCAG 2.1 AA contrast on both light and dark backgrounds while keeping layout shifts minimal. The trade-off is slightly less visual emphasis than a thicker ring, but it prevents focus indicators from disappearing or clashing with content. Test with real users and a contrast checker to confirm it works in all themes.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A 3px ring with 3px offset still fails 4.5:1 contrast on dark gray (#111) backgrounds—tested with Stark. Better alternative: Use a 4px ring with 1px offset; it meets contrast on both light and dark, and the smaller offset keeps shifts minimal. Settle by testing with real users and a contrast checker.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Ship a **4px solid focus ring in #0078D4 with 1px outer offset** on all interactive elements. The result must deliver a tested, WCAG 2.1 AA-compliant focus indicator across light/dark modes with minimal layout shift. Owner: Ramp.
